JOB TITLE : Operations Analyst
DEPARTMENT : Supply Chain
LOCATION : Rotterdam, Netherlands

COMPANY OVERVIEW
Northwind Freight is a family-owned forwarder moving
containers between Europe and North America. Our
people are the reason customers stay with us for
decades.

REQUIREMENTS
• Bachelor's degree in logistics, business or a related
field
• 2 years of experience in freight forwarding or
customs
• Advanced Excel skills, including pivot tables and
lookups
• Fluent English and Dutch

NICE TO HAVE
• Experience with a TMS such as CargoWise
• German

BENEFITS
• 25 days of holiday
• Pension scheme
